cs.t: Many years ago I had a Northgate Omnikey keyboard. Pretty much everything I've used since has been a disappointment. My go-to mouse for many years has been the Kensington Orbital trackball.
cs.th: What's the best keyboard and mouse you owned?

cs.t: For many years I've used a basic Kensington Orbital. I've got one on my desk at work. Our computers get refreshed every three years, but the IT guys know anyone who tries to take away my trackball will lose a hand.
cs.th: 20 Years Ago, Microsoft introduced its optical mouse
